name: Tax agents & filing (category guide)
summary: Category entry for IR21 clearance disputes, ESOP/RSU filing without a local IR8A, dual-residency / COR needs, foreign-income myths, and NOA/GIRO clock stress — hire when myTax Portal alone is not enough.
body: Most salary-only EP years do not need a paid tax agent — file via myTax Portal, set GIRO before the NOA due date, and keep IR8A / AIS figures. Engage a Singapore tax professional when IR21 withhold looks wrong against your package (housing, equity, leave encashment), when a US/UK/Australia filer needs Certificate of Residence or DTA help, when overseas remote income or rental sits outside a clean IR8A, or when ESOP/RSU gains land without a local entity able to report them. Employer tax clearance (Form IR21) is an employer duty — agents help you challenge income classification and residual bills, not skip withhold. Ask whether the firm regularly clears foreign work-pass leavers and equity awards; compare fixed engagement fees against a one-hour IRAS myTax Mail first. This is a category guide, not a ranked firm list — verify any adviser against IRAS tax-agent materials and your own engagement letter. Hosting an LTVP parent can create dual-residency and dependant-relief questions that myTax alone will not answer — ask whether the firm has cleared foreign-parent living costs and departure clearances before you invent a DIY schedule.
whenToEngage: IR21 withhold looks inflated vs package / equity
ESOP or RSU gains with no local IR8A path
Need Certificate of Residence / DTA claim help
Foreign-source income or multi-year exit cleanup
NOA / GIRO clocks collide with a job hop or leave
LTVP parent living costs / dual-residency tax questions
